a.xlink:title: Samples and triangulates one request, returning null when local terrain is absent.
Inverts the local flat projection for a finite east/north position.
Returns interpolated terrain elevation, or no value when no valid post contributes.
Appends possibly duplicated candidate triangle ordinals for bounded unwrapped bounds.
Returns one decoded elevation in metres, excluding the DTED no-data sentinel.
Returns true when dimensions and storage form a bounded usable DTED cell.
